THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/543 dated 30.10.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the village called Thoddaveli in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/62, of Thoddaveli in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot A – Extent: 0.3249 Hectare North: Road and Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known); East: Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known) and Road; South: Lots K,H,G,F,E,D,C,B, Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known) and Road; West: Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known) and Road.

02. Lot B – Thoddavelikaani – Extent: 0.0109 Hectare North: Road and Lot A(Road); East: Lot A(Road) and Lot C; South: Lot C and Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known); West: Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known) and Road.

03. Lot C – Thoddavelikaani – Extent: 0.0863 Hectare North: Lot B and Lot A(Road); East: Lot A(Road), Road and Lot D; South: Lot D and Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known); West: Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known) and Lot B.

04. Lot D – Thoddavelikaani – Extent: 0.0991 Hectare North: Lot C and Lot A (Road); East: Lot A(Road) and Lot E; South: Lot E and Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known); West: Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known) and Lot C.

05. Lot E – Thoddavelikaani – Extent: 0.0426 Hectare North: Lot D and Lot A(Road); East: Lot A(Road) and Lot F(Road); South: Lot F(Road), Road and Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known); West: Thoddavelikaani (Claimant not known) and Lot D.
